# Isaiah Chapter 53 -- The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**53:1** Who [mi] has-believed [he'emin] our-report [li-shemu'atenu]? And-the-arm [u-zero'a] of-the-LORD [YHVH] — upon whom [al mi] has-it-been-revealed [niglata]?

**53:2** And-he-grew-up [va-ya'al] like-a-young-plant [ka-yoneq] before-him [lefanav], and-like-a-root [ve-kha-shoresh] from-dry [mi-eretz] ground [tziyyah]; he-had-no [lo] form [to'ar] to-him [lo] and-no [ve-lo] majesty [hadar]; and-we-looked [ve-nir'ehu] — and-no [ve-lo] appearance [mar'eh] that-we-should-desire-him [ve-nechmadehu].

**53:3** He-was-despised [nivzeh] and-rejected [va-chadal] by-men [ishim], a-man [ish] of-sorrows [makh'ovot] and-acquainted [vi-yadu'a] with-grief [choli]; and-like-one-from-whom [u-khe-master] [men] hide [panim] their-faces [mimmennu] he-was-despised [nivzeh], and-we-did-not [ve-lo] esteem-him [chashavnuhu].

**53:4** Surely [akhen] our-griefs [cholayenu] he [hu] bore [nasa], and-our-sorrows [u-makh'oveinu] he-carried-them [sevalm]; but-we [va-anachnu] esteemed-him [chashavnuhu] stricken [nagua], struck [mukkeh] by-God [Elohim], and-afflicted [u-me'unneh].

**53:5** But-he [ve-hu] was-pierced [mecholal] for-our-transgressions [mi-pesha'einu], crushed [medukka] for-our-iniquities [me-avonotenu]; the-chastisement [musar] of-our-peace [shelomenu] [was] upon-him [alav], and-by-his-wounds [u-va-chaburato] we-are-healed [nirpa lanu].

**53:6** All-of-us [kullanu] like-sheep [ka-tzon] have-gone-astray [ta'inu]; each [ish] to-his-own-way [le-darkho] we-have-turned [paninu]; and-the-LORD [va-YHVH] has-laid [hipgi'a] on-him [bo] the-iniquity [et avon] of-us-all [kullanu].

**53:7** He-was-oppressed [niggas] and-he [ve-hu] was-afflicted [na'aneh], and-he-did-not [ve-lo] open [yiftach] his-mouth [pihu]; like-a-lamb [ka-seh] to-the-slaughter [la-tevach] he-was-led [yuval], and-like-a-ewe [u-khe-rachel] before [lifnei] her-shearers [gozzeha] is-silent [ne'elamah] — and-he-did-not [ve-lo] open [yiftach] his-mouth [pihu].

**53:8** From-oppression [me-otzer] and-from-judgment [u-mi-mishpat] he-was-taken [luqqach]; and-his-generation [ve-et doro] — who [mi] considered [yesochech]? For he-was-cut-off [ki nigzar] from-the-land [me-eretz] of-the-living [chayyim]; for-the-transgression [mi-pesha] of-my-people [ammi] [was] the-stroke [nega] to-him [lamo].

**53:9** And-they-made [va-yitten] his-grave [qivro] with the-wicked [et resha'im] and-with [ve-et] the-rich [ashir] in-his-death [be-motav], although [al] he-had-done [asah] no-violence [lo chamas], and-there-was-no [ve-lo] deceit [mirmah] in-his-mouth [be-fiv].

**53:10** But-the-LORD [va-YHVH] was-pleased [chafetz] to-crush-him [dakkeo]; he-made-him-sick [hecheli]. If [im] his-soul [nafsho] makes [tasim] a-guilt-offering [asham], he-shall-see [yir'eh] offspring [zera], he-shall-prolong [ya'arikh] [his] days [yamim]; and-the-will [ve-chefetz] of-the-LORD [YHVH] shall-prosper [yitzlach] in-his-hand [be-yado].

**53:11** From-the-travail [me-amal] of-his-soul [nafsho] he-shall-see [yir'eh] [light] and-be-satisfied [yisba]; by-his-knowledge [be-da'to] the-righteous-one [tzaddiq], my-servant [avdi], shall-make-many-righteous [yatzdiq la-rabbim], and-their-iniquities [va-avonotam] he [hu] shall-bear [yisbol].

**53:12** Therefore [lakhen] I-will-divide [achalleq] to-him [lo] among-the-great [ba-rabbim], and-with [ve-et] the-strong [atzumim] he-shall-divide [yechalleq] spoil [shalal]; because [tachat asher] he-poured-out [he'erah] his-soul [nafsho] to-death [la-mavet] and-was-numbered [ve-et posh'im nimnah] with-the-transgressors; yet-he [ve-hu] bore [nasa] the-sin [chet] of-many [rabbim], and-for-the-transgressors [ve-la-posh'im] he-intercedes [yafgi'a].

---

## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.3 — "man of sorrows" (ish makh'ovot):** Literally "man of pains." The word *makh'ov* denotes physical or psychological pain. Combined with *yadu'a choli* ("acquainted with sickness/grief"), the portrait is of one intimately familiar with human suffering.

**v.5 — "pierced" (mecholal):** The Hebrew *mecholal* (from *chalal*, "to pierce/profane/wound") is the chapter's most theologically charged term. The passive participle with the preposition *mi-* ("from/because of") establishes substitutionary suffering: he was pierced *because of* our transgressions.

**v.10 — "guilt offering" (asham):** The word *asham* is a technical sacrificial term (Leviticus 5:14–19) for an offering that compensates for violation of sacred things. Applying it to a person is unprecedented in the Hebrew Bible.

**v.11 — "he shall see [light]":** The word "light" (*or*) appears in 1QIsaᵃ (the Great Isaiah Scroll from Qumran) and the LXX but is absent from the MT. Most modern translations include it. EMET notes the variant.

*-- EMET*
